record.body:
verdict: NEEDS_WORK
findings:
  - task: phase
    kind: behavior-bug
    expected: The product index is a new landing page, and the existing overlay and journal flows still end at the screen the user came from. R27 and the Interfaces section say the other routes are unchanged.
    observed: Journal Back (`close-journal` in Journal.svelte) and the Esc handler in App.svelte call `openHash("")`. `closeDetail` falls back to `openHash("")` when the back stack is empty, for example after opening a `#/task/..` or `#/phase/..` deep link. Before this phase `""` was the effort Home. Now `""` is the product index, so the user loses the effort context. Overlays opened from `#/effort/<name>` return correctly through the back stack. No test covers journal close or a deep-link close landing on the index.
    severity: minor
  - task: area-chip-started / product-index
    kind: missing-test
    expected: Every behavior added in the phase has a test that fails without it.
    observed: The `Array.isArray(data) ? data : []` guard in bindAreas (areas.svelte.ts) has no test. It appears to exist only so test stubs that return a snapshot object for every URL do not crash `.find`. In production it silently hides a malformed `/api/areas` response, because `areas.error` stays empty. Either test it and set `areas.error` on a non-array response, or fix the stubs and drop the guard.
    severity: minor
  - task: phase
    kind: spec-gap
    expected: R27 says the existing deep-link and overlay tests pass unchanged. The product-index task says not to change `dialogs.test.ts` and to stop and report if it fails.
    observed: `dialogs.test.ts` changed. The import now includes `effortHref`, and the focus-return test sets `window.location.hash = effortHref("dashboard")` before mounting. The recorded decision `dialogs-test-mount-route` justifies this. The verify check only diffs `deepLinks.test.ts`, `detail.test.ts` and `detailNav.test.ts`, so the dialogs edit goes unchecked. The assertions are unchanged, so this needs a human decision on whether it counts as unchanged.
    severity: judgment
  - task: area-page
    kind: spec-gap
    expected: The area-page task replaces the old R7 to R10 area-screen tests with tests that match the new page. The old behavior of linking a moved idea to its phase is not listed as removed.
    observed: The old `areas.test.ts` R8 asserted `data-idea-link="phase"` linking to `#/phase/dashboard/areas-and-ideas`. The new Started-as-efforts lines link only to the effort. R12 and R13 require only the effort link, so this matches the spec, but the phase link and its test are gone with no recorded decision. Confirm that dropping it is intended.
    severity: judgment
  - task: areas-promoted-ideas
    kind: behavior-bug
    expected: A promoted idea joins the area its effort is placed in. When the effort has no placement, the idea keeps its own `area`.
    observed: `_home_area` tests `effort in placed`, and `placed` stores `area or ""`. A live placement with an empty `area` therefore sends the promoted idea to `""`, and it appears in no area, instead of falling back to the idea's own area. The frozen R14 tests do not cover this. Also, `AreaIdea.area` is now the idea's own `area`, not the listing area's subject. That is required by the frozen oracle, so the response shape and OpenAPI are unaffected.
    severity: minor
  - task: product-index
    kind: missing-test
    expected: The R6 backend test in `tests/dashboard/test_areas.py` backs the claim that cards show the open idea count.
    observed: It only greps the sources of `ProductIndex.svelte` and `AreaCard.svelte` for the strings `data-product-index`, `data-area-card` and `openIdeas`. It does not test behavior. The vitest `productIndex.test.ts` R5 covers the behavior properly, so this is redundant and weak, not a gap.
    severity: minor
integration:
  interfaces: Routes `#/` ProductIndex, `#/area/<s>` Area, `#/effort/<n>` Home. router.ts adds `effort` and `effortName()`; `routeLabel` removed. detail.ts adds `effortHref`. lib/state/areas.ts holds groupByArea, areaRollup, railItems, breadcrumbParts, firstSentence, startedIdeas. Breadcrumb.svelte replaces top-bar crumbs. Rail.svelte replaces EffortRail.svelte. Backend load_areas reads composer:placement; response shape unchanged. e2e/serve.py seeds an area and placement.
  assumptions: Used only the brief, the diff and the tree. Did not run tests, e2e or lint. Assumed the composer schema exists for canon init --schemas composer. Assumed jsdom dispatches hashchange on anchor clicks.
  invariants: Hash routing only PASS. Product index and area page write nothing PASS. An idea never renders among the efforts PASS. The URL decides the selected effort PASS (one render tick may show the old effort). An effort belongs to at most one area PASS. Out-of-task test edits PASS (mount routes and selectors only). Dead code none. Accessibility: no issue beyond the whole breadcrumb sitting inside the existing aria-live region.
  conflicts: None between pieces. The phase moves the landing page to the product index, so journal and overlay fallbacks to `""` now land on the index (first finding).
(Condensed by the parent for storage; the full reviewer report is in the session transcript.)
record.subject: area-levels-review
